Yes — Mira has a confirmed mild egg allergy (hives), noted by Riverdale Pediatrics. Worth flagging clearly to any new caregiver, along with what to watch for and what you'd want them to do if hives show up.

A couple of things to pass along with it:

- What reaction to expect (mild hives) and that it's confirmed by her pediatric office, not just suspected.
- Any food she's regularly given that contains egg, so the caregiver knows what to avoid or substitute.

If it'd help, I can put together a short written note for the caregiver with this info.
